facts.label: Comparar e escolher
facts.sub: Use adjetivo + er + than para comparar e I’d like para pedir: The soup is cheaper than the salad. I’d like the chicken.

facts.label: Comparar
facts.sub: Para comparar duas coisas, use adjetivo + er + than: The soup is warmer than the salad. Com palavras curtas, adicione er. Cheap vira cheaper e warm vira warmer.

facts.label: Bom e melhor
facts.sub: Good é irregular. O comparativo é better: The soup is better. Não diga more good nem gooder. Pergunte What is better today? para pedir uma sugestão.

pages.title: A cozy restaurant · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in a cozy restaurant in Dublin. Rain taps on the window. Blake carries a tray of glasses. His friend Leo sits near the door. Leo is cold and hungry. He cannot decide what to eat.
“Hi, Leo! Would you like soup or salad?” says Blake. “What is better today?” says Leo. “The soup is warmer and cheaper than the salad.” says Blake.
